sub_scenario.one_line: clinical scheduling coordinator: request a lower-demand offsite window

dialogue.content: I spent the first hour tidying the waitlist ledger and closing stale entries.
Anything still open?
Two items, both with owners.
The clinic diary review wrapped early today.
Any surprises in it?
None worth recording.
I can join a staff breakfast after a regular shift and still work a full day.
Are normal team events difficult?
No, not when I have slept normally.
Someone new shadowed me in the scheduling pod this morning.
Did that slow you down?
A little, but the questions were good ones.
I batched my replies about the triage weeks into one message before lunch.
Cleaner than drip-feeding answers.
Much cleaner.
I covered the midnight cancellation list and finished reconciling the waitlist at 11:20 on Thursday.
What capacity remained?
By midafternoon my concentration was thin and I needed quiet time.
I attended a ninety-minute planning meeting last Friday with no trouble.
What was different about that day?
I had not been awake managing urgent calls overnight.
I archived last cycle's notes on the clinic diary and set up the new folder.
A fresh start?
As fresh as these things get.
Night triage calls have aggravated my migraines this month, especially when I look at screens for long periods.
Does that affect group sessions?
Noise and screens make the fog last longer.
A vendor call about the waitlist ledger ran long but ended well.
Worth the time?
This one, yes.
I walked through the scheduling pod checklist with the new starter.
How did they do?
Careful and quick, a good sign.
Quiet afternoon; I cleared the backlog around the triage weeks.
A rare day.
I did not waste it.
I flagged a small inconsistency in the clinic diary records and fixed it at the source.
Root cause or symptom?
Root cause, for once.
My vestibular assessment is fixed for Thursday at 17:15 because the specialist only visits our clinic once a month.
Could it move?
Not without losing this month's assessment.
I sketched next week's plan for the triage weeks before leaving.
Ahead of schedule?
Ahead enough to sleep well.
Lunch walk, then a clean pass through the waitlist ledger updates.
Does the walk help?
It resets the afternoon.
After migraine nights I use water and a quiet break rather than coffee.
Why not use caffeine?
It makes the rebound headache worse.
A colleague says attending the offsite will show I am ready for regional coordination.
Is that appealing?
Yes, but it does not change the appointment or the migraine.
I closed the week by updating the scheduling pod handover notes.
Anything unusual to hand over?
Blessedly little.
Facilities has invited me to a Thursday afternoon offsite after I cover the cancellation list overnight. How should I respond?
